plan.title: Paired treatment vs control DE + pathway enrichment
plan.analytical_narrative: Five subjects each contribute a control and a treated blood sample (paired design, raw STAR/featureCounts gene counts, 12000 genes x 10 samples). The research question — which genes respond to treatment within each subject — is answered by a within-subject (paired) differential expression test: DESeq2 with design ~subject + condition, which removes between-subject variation and isolates the treatment effect. Steps proceed: (1) sample-structure QC on variance-stabilized counts to confirm subjects pair correctly and no sample is an outlier before any test is trusted; (2) minimal low-count pre-filtering; (3) DESeq2 Wald test on the condition coefficient with apeglm shrinkage of the fold change; (4) BH-adjusted significance calling with independent filtering and inspection of the p-value histogram; (5) a robustness cross-check with edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the identical paired design, reporting the intersection as the high-confidence gene set; (6) preranked fgsea enrichment on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (secondary, both human gene sets confirmed present in the reference store) to give the responding genes functional context; (7) a consolidated report with fit diagnostics, gene tables (unshrunken and shrunken LFC), enrichment tables with leading-edge genes, and a full reproducibility record. No batch structure is declared or suspected beyond the subject-pairing itself, so no separate batch correction step is included.
